'''Shadowsilk''' was a flat-black material designed by [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]]. The material was most known for its ability to absorb light and dampen sounds made by contact with the material. This made it ideal for stealth applications in low light or nighttime conditions.

It was primarily used in the manufacture of [[shadowsuit]]s.
